note: Alberta Parks campground in Little Elbow PRA at the end of Hwy 66 (closed Dec 1 to May 15) beside the Elbow River in Kananaskis, with well-treed, well-spaced sites and 30 walk-in tent sites. The hand-pump water is not drinkable, so bring water. Firewood is sold at the McLean Creek campground store. The separate Little Elbow Equestrian campground shares the area. --Claude
